subject.title: fix(browser): stop screenshot vision-failure fallback from injecting raw base64

question: When configured image understanding fails for a browser screenshot, should OpenClaw return a text-only failure result, or preserve raw screenshot recovery for the primary model while preventing that image from persisting into later session context?
rationale: The branch fixes a real session-state defect but deliberately removes an existing fallback that may be relied on by users whose primary model can still understand the screenshot; source and tests cannot determine which recovery behavior maintainers want as the stable product contract.

options.title: Approve text-only configured failures
options.body: Make the proposed text-only failure/share result the explicit contract, accepting that the screenshot is not automatically available to the primary model after configured vision fails.

options.title: Preserve one-turn image recovery safely
options.body: Keep raw screenshot recovery only if the owner wants it, then move the fix to the session/history boundary so the image cannot contaminate later completed turns.

recommendation.title: Approve text-only configured failures
recommendation.body: Make the proposed text-only failure/share result the explicit contract, accepting that the screenshot is not automatically available to the primary model after configured vision fails.

likelyOwner.reason: A feature-history owner could not be identified from the supplied context without guessing; the browser-plugin owner should make the recovery-contract decision.
